<OJP xmlns="http://www.vdv.de/ojp" xmlns:siri="http://www.siri.org.uk/siri" version="2.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:schemaLocation="http://www.vdv.de/ojp OJP_changes_for_v1.1/OJP.xsd">
    <OJPRequest>
        <siri:ServiceRequest>
            <siri:RequestTimestamp>{{$isoTimestamp}}</siri:RequestTimestamp>
            <siri:RequestorRef>MENTZRegTest</siri:RequestorRef>
            <OJPTripRequest>
                <siri:RequestTimestamp>{{$isoTimestamp}}</siri:RequestTimestamp>
                <siri:MessageIdentifier>2161-TR-1h</siri:MessageIdentifier>
                <Origin>
                    <PlaceRef>
                        <siri:StopPointRef>8592086</siri:StopPointRef>
                        <Name>
                            <Text>Lausanne, Ouchy-Olympique)</Text>
                        </Name>
                    </PlaceRef>
                    <DepArrTime>{{fixedTimestamp}}</DepArrTime>
                </Origin>
                <Destination>
                    <PlaceRef>
                        <siri:StopPointRef>8592074</siri:StopPointRef>
                        <Name>
                            <Text>Lausanne, Mon Repos</Text>
                        </Name>
                    </PlaceRef>
                </Destination>
                <Params>
                  <ModeAndModeOfOperationFilter>
                    <Exclude>false</Exclude>
                    <PtMode>metro</PtMode>
                  </ModeAndModeOfOperationFilter>
                  <NumberOfResults>1</NumberOfResults>
                  <NumberOfResultsBefore>0</NumberOfResultsBefore>
                  <NumberOfResultsAfter>1</NumberOfResultsAfter>
                  <UseRealtimeData>full</UseRealtimeData>
                  <IncludeAllRestrictedLines>true</IncludeAllRestrictedLines>
                  <IncludeTrackSections>false</IncludeTrackSections>
                  <IncludeLegProjection>false</IncludeLegProjection>
                  <IncludeIntermediateStops>true</IncludeIntermediateStops>
                </Params>
            </OJPTripRequest>
        </siri:ServiceRequest>
    </OJPRequest>
</OJP>
